(#{item.orderId}, #{item.orderNo}, #{item.type}, #{item.productId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.productCode}, #{item.skuCode}, #{item.productName}, #{item.skuAttrs}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.stockBefore}, #{item.stockAfter}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.createUser})
mapper.select:
select l.*, cu.name as create_user_name from stock_ledger l left join employee cu on cu.id = l.create_user
and l.type = #{type}
and l.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
and (l.product_code like concat('%', #{code}, '%') or l.sku_code like concat('%', #{code}, '%'))
and l.create_time >= #{beginDate}
and l.create_time < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
order by l.create_time desc, l.id desc
